entity.name: Ankit Jha
entity.description: Independent developer building Hydra and other open-source, local-first developer tooling under the Uvansa product umbrella.

projects.name: Hydra
projects.description: Hydra is an open source CLI (hyctl), written in Go, that routes developer tasks across every AI model on your machine to a target confidence of correctness. It cuts LLM API costs 70-85% by using cheap or local models for simple tasks and reserving frontier models for work that needs them, enforces PII/local-only policy, and logs spend.
